properties.areaDesc: Waters from Baffin Bay to Port Mansfield TX from 20 to 60 NM
properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued November 6 at 5:23AM CST until November 6 at 6:00AM CST by NWS Brownsville TX
properties.description:
SMWBRO

The National Weather Service in Brownsville has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Waters from Baffin Bay to Port Mansfield TX from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 600 AM CST.

* At 523 AM CST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located 38 nm northeast of Laguna Madre, moving
southeast at 15 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* The severe thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.
properties.instruction:
Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

flood stage in the next couple days, with a continued rise through
Minor flood stage this weekend and early next week.

forecast.

* WHERE...St Johns River near Sanford.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

Stone Island and Still Brook subdivisions. Pool enclosures and
patios become flooded. Water covers many of the roads. Flooding

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7:30 PM EST Thursday the stage was 5.2 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 4.2 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage early

Additional rises are possible thereafter.
- Flood stage is 5.5 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.description:
FFWPHI

The National Weather Service in Mount Holly has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Central Burlington County in southern New Jersey...
Central Camden County in southern New Jersey...
Central Gloucester County in southern New Jersey...

* Until 1015 AM EST.

* At 612 AM EST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain
have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1.5 to 2.5 inches in 1
hour. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are possible in
the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Cherry Hill, Evesham, Mount Laurel, Deptford, Voorhees, Medford,
West Deptford, Glassboro, Lindenwold, Lumberton and Bellmawr.
